3d-cutie-easter-farm-animals-stl-3d-mode.d: A pocket-sized barnyard of chicks, lambs, and bunnies with rounded, toy-like charm. They print small and forgiving, which makes them ideal for Easter baskets.

bunny-egg-decor-easter-egg-figurine-for-.d: An egg-shaped bunny that balances the two icons of the season in one smooth form. It prints in one go with no supports, so it is easy to batch for a table centerpiece.

3d-easter-bunny-decor.d: A gentle rabbit with soft ears that anchors a spring vignette on a console or side table. Matte pastel filament keeps the look calm and seasonal.

3d-kawaii-easter-bunny-figurine-090-3d-m.d: Big eyes, tiny paws, and a pastel body make this bunny hard to resist. It is a sweet shelf companion long after the chocolate is gone.

bunny-figurine-with-flowers-spring-rabbi.d: A rabbit framed by blooming flowers that captures the first warm week of spring. Two-tone printing gives the petals a fresh pop against the fur.

easter-gnome-holder-cute-spring-gnome.d: A bearded spring gnome that holds treats or small eggs in its outstretched hands. It doubles as a candy dish and a cheerful little greeter.

3d-minimalist-bunny-figurines-stl-093.d: Clean, sculptural bunnies with no fuss and plenty of presence. They suit modern shelves and print beautifully in single muted tones.

easter-bunny-chocolate-egg-holder-stl.d: A bunny that presents a chocolate egg like a tiny pedestal. It turns an ordinary candy into a little gift moment at the table.

3d-mini-farm-animals-easter-spring-stl.d: A micro menagerie of farm friends sized for windowsills and egg carton displays. Print a whole set in one evening for a playful spring scene.

heart-gnome-figure.d: A gnome cradling a heart that works for both Valentine's week and spring shelves. The soft beard and warm heart print nicely in two tones.

easter-bunny-egg-bundle-2.d: A matched set of bunnies and eggs for dressing a mantel or kids' table. The pieces coordinate in scale, so the display looks curated rather than collected.

easter-bunny-gnome-3.d: A gnome with bunny ears that merges two seasonal mascots into one friendly figure. It is quick to print and instantly recognizable across the room.

cherry-blossom-coaster-3d-print-stl.d: Delicate blossom petals frame a coaster that brings spring to the coffee table. It prints flat and fast, and the petal relief adds a handmade feel.

sakura-floral-coaster-laser-cut-svg.d: A layered sakura pattern for coasters with clean lines and quiet elegance. The design suits both 3D printing and laser cutting for spring table sets.

easter-bunny-nutcracker-spring-decor-stl.d: A nutcracker dressed as an Easter bunny bridges the seasons with a wink of whimsy. He stands proud on a spring table and tucks away neatly once the holiday passes.
